name: ASM · 06 Vuln Checks
description: Stage 6: on the Diff delta only. nuclei (medium+), ffuf sensitive paths, katana crawl; nuclei DAST and dalfox only when allow_intrusive. Writes findings/vuln.jsonl.

parameters.jsCode:
const STAGE = 'vuln';
const MAX_MINUTES = 360;
const BODY = "DF="$R/diff"
mkdir -p "$R/findings" ffuf
python3 - "$R" <<'PY'
import ipaddress, sys
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
R = Path(sys.argv[1])
read = lambda p: [l.strip() for l in p.read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()] if p.exists() else []
ips = set(read(R / "discovery/ips.txt"))
service = {l.split("\t")[0] for l in read(R / "discovery/shared_hosts.txt") if "\tservice" in l}

def allowed(t):
    host = urlsplit(t if "://" in t else "//" + t).hostname or ""
    try:
        ipaddress.ip_address(host)
        return host in ips
    except ValueError:
        return host not in service

web = [t for t in read(R / "diff/delta_web.txt") if allowed(t)]
net = [t for t in read(R / "diff/delta_net.txt") if allowed(t)]
dropped = len(read(R / "diff/delta_web.txt")) + len(read(R / "diff/delta_net.txt")) - len(web) - len(net)
Path("nuclei_targets.txt").write_text("".join(f"{t}\n" for t in sorted(set(web + net))))
Path("web_targets.txt").write_text("".join(f"{t}\n" for t in web[:200]))
Path("dropped_shared.txt").write_text(f"{dropped}\n")
PY
touch nuclei_targets.txt web_targets.txt
ETAGS="dos,fuzz"
[ "$INTRUSIVE" = 1 ] || ETAGS="$ETAGS,intrusive"

: > nuclei.jsonl
if [ -s nuclei_targets.txt ]; then
  timeout 180m nuclei -l nuclei_targets.txt -severity medium,high,critical \
    -tags cve,exposure,misconfig,default-login,takeover -etags "$ETAGS" \
    -rl "$RATE" -c 10 -bs 10 -dr -jsonl -o nuclei.jsonl -silent -nc -duc >/dev/null 2>nuclei.log || true
  touch nuclei.jsonl
fi

cat > paths.txt <<'EOF'
.git/config
.git/HEAD
.svn/entries
.hg/hgrc
.env
.env.bak
.env.local
.env.production
.DS_Store
.aws/credentials
.ssh/id_rsa
id_rsa
config.json
config.php.bak
wp-config.php.bak
web.config
.htpasswd
docker-compose.yml
backup.zip
backup.tar.gz
db.sql
dump.sql
server-status
server-info
phpinfo.php
actuator
actuator/env
actuator/heapdump
actuator/mappings
trace.axd
elmah.axd
swagger.json
openapi.json
v2/api-docs
v3/api-docs
swagger-ui.html
graphql
debug
console
_profiler
EOF

i=0
while read -r u; do
  i=$((i + 1))
  base="${u%/}"
  timeout 5m ffuf -u "$base/FUZZ" -w paths.txt -ac -mc 200 -t 5 -rate "$RATE" -timeout 10 -s \
    -of json -o "ffuf/$i.json" >/dev/null 2>>ffuf.log || true
done < web_targets.txt

: > katana.jsonl
if [ -s web_targets.txt ]; then
  timeout 60m katana -list web_targets.txt -fs fqdn -or -ob -jc -d 2 -ct 300 -rl "$RATE" -silent -nc -jsonl -o katana.jsonl \
    -ef png,jpg,jpeg,gif,svg,css,woff,woff2,ttf,eot,ico,mp4,webp,pdf >/dev/null 2>katana.log || true
  touch katana.jsonl
fi

python3 - "$R/scope/scope.py" <<'PY' > params.txt
import json, sys
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, parse_qsl
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1].rsplit("/", 1)[0])
from scope import name_ok, ip_ok
seen, out = set(), []
for line in open("katana.jsonl"):
    try:
        u = (json.loads(line).get("request") or {}).get("endpoint", "")
    except ValueError:
        continue
    p = urlsplit(u)
    if not p.query or not (name_ok(p.hostname or "") or ip_ok(p.hostname or "")):
        continue
    key = (p.scheme, p.netloc, p.path, tuple(sorted(k for k, _ in parse_qsl(p.query))))
    if key in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(key)
    out.append(u)
print("\n".join(out[:300]))
PY
[ -s katana.jsonl ] && gzip -f katana.jsonl

: > nuclei_dast.jsonl
: > dalfox.json
if [ "$INTRUSIVE" = 1 ] && [ -s params.txt ]; then
  timeout 90m nuclei -l params.txt -dast -severity medium,high,critical -rl "$RATE" -c 10 \
    -dr -jsonl -o nuclei_dast.jsonl -silent -nc -duc >/dev/null 2>nuclei_dast.log || true
  timeout 90m docker run --rm -i --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$S:/w" -w /w \
    hahwul/dalfox:v2.12.0 file /w/params.txt --silence --no-color --skip-bav --worker 5 \
    --format json -o /w/dalfox.json >/dev/null 2>dalfox.log || true
  touch nuclei_dast.jsonl dalfox.json
fi

python3 - "$ENG" "$R/findings/vuln.jsonl" "$S" <<'PY'
import glob, json, sys
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
eng, dst, evid = sys.argv[1:4]
HIGH = (".git/", ".svn/", ".hg/", ".env", ".aws/", "id_rsa", ".ssh/", "heapdump", "actuator/env", ".htpasswd", "dump.sql", "db.sql", "backup.")
LOW = ("swagger", "api-docs", "openapi", "graphql", "_profiler", "console", "debug")
out, seen = [], set()

def host_of(u):
    h = urlsplit(u if "://" in u else "//" + u).hostname
    return (h or "").lower()

def add(rec):
    if rec["finding_key"] in seen:
        return
    seen.add(rec["finding_key"])
    rec["evidence_dir"] = evid
    out.append(rec)

for src in ("nuclei.jsonl", "nuclei_dast.jsonl"):
    for line in open(src):
        try:
            f = json.loads(line)
        except ValueError:
            continue
        info = f.get("info") or {}
        m = f.get("matched-at") or f.get("host", "")
        tid = f.get("template-id", "")
        detail = " ".join(x for x in [info.get("description", ""), "extracted: " + ", ".join(f.get("extracted-results") or []) if f.get("extracted-results") else "", "matcher: " + f["matcher-name"] if f.get("matcher-name") else ""] if x)
        add({"finding_key": f"{eng}|nuclei|{tid}|{m}", "source": "nuclei-dast" if "dast" in src else "nuclei",
             "host": host_of(m), "url": m, "template_id": tid, "name": info.get("name", tid),
             "severity": info.get("severity", "unknown"), "matched_at": m, "detail": detail[:600]})

for path in glob.glob("ffuf/*.json"):
    try:
        data = json.load(open(path))
    except ValueError:
        continue
    for r in data.get("results") or []:
        word = (r.get("input") or {}).get("FUZZ", "")
        url = r.get("url", "")
        sev = "high" if any(x in word for x in HIGH) else "low" if any(x in word for x in LOW) else "medium"
        base = url[: -len(word)] if word and url.endswith(word) else url
        add({"finding_key": f"{eng}|ffuf|{word}|{base}", "source": "ffuf", "host": host_of(url), "url": url,
             "template_id": f"exposed-path:{word}", "name": f"Exposed path /{word}", "severity": sev,
             "matched_at": url, "detail": f"HTTP {r.get('status')} length {r.get('length')} words {r.get('words')}"})

try:
    raw = open("dalfox.json").read().strip()
    items = json.loads(raw) if raw.startswith("[") else [json.loads(l) for l in raw.splitlines() if l.strip().startswith("{")]
except ValueError:
    items = []
for d in items:
    if not isinstance(d, dict) or not d.get("type"):
        continue
    poc = d.get("data") or d.get("poc") or ""
    param = d.get("param", "")
    base = poc.split("?")[0]
    add({"finding_key": f"{eng}|dalfox|{param}|{base}", "source": "dalfox", "host": host_of(poc), "url": poc,
         "template_id": f"dalfox-{d.get('type')}", "name": f"Reflected XSS ({d.get('type')}) in {param}",
         "severity": (d.get("severity") or "medium").lower(), "matched_at": poc,
         "detail": f"{d.get('method', '')} {d.get('inject_type', '')} {d.get('message_str', '')}"[:600]})

with open(dst, "w") as fh:
    for o in out:
        fh.write(json.dumps(o) + "\n")
counts = {}
for o in out:
    counts[o["source"]] = counts.get(o["source"], 0) + 1
json.dump({"vuln_findings": len(out), "by_source": counts}, open("result.json", "w"))
PY
";
const c = $input.first().json;
const SAFE = /^[A-Za-z0-9_./:-]+$/;
const q = (k) => {
  const v = String(c[k] ?? '');
  if (!SAFE.test(v)) throw new Error(`Unsafe or missing context value for ${k}: ${v}`);
  return `'${v}'`;
};
const int = (v, lo, hi, d) => Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(v ?? d, 10) || d, lo), hi);
const header = [
  '#!/usr/bin/env bash',
  'set -uo pipefail',
  `R=${q('run_dir')}`,
  `S=${q('run_dir').slice(0, -1)}/${STAGE}'`,
  `ENG=${q('engagement')}`,
  `RUN_ID=${q('run_id')}`,
  `STATE=${q('state_dir')}`,
  `RATE=${int(c.rate, 1, 500, 50)}`,
  `PORT_RATE=${int(c.port_rate, 50, 2000, 500)}`,
  `INTRUSIVE=${c.intrusive === true ? 1 : 0}`,
  `PERMUTE=${c.permute === true ? 1 : 0}`,
  'mkdir -p "$S" && cd "$S" || exit 1',
  ''
].join('
');
return [{ json: { job_dir: `${c.run_dir}/${STAGE}`, script: header + BODY, max_minutes: MAX_MINUTES } }];
